subject: I want one....

body:
Its a driving game, important things needed to drive: a car, wheels, brakes, accelerator, mirrors to see whos sneaking up behind you(back button is fine), a decent place to sit, a control device to make the car turn, may be some indicators, to warn drivers where your going, and a speedometer to know how fast your going for insurance purposes.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
